notes: Final file has 39 units. (must-not vs should-not, resolved must-not); (4) actor on two P04 statements. Policy type agreed on every matched unit. Four A-only units were real AI statements and were kept (two definitions of covered software, two 'follow your instructors guidelines' sentences). B's one unique unit (scope sentence 'the responsible use of artificial intelligence') was a navigation-style intro and was dropped. Stance matched on all three documents (delegates). new_types empty on both sides.
